cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Don’t Go
cards.instruction: Create reasons another player must stay with you. Never directly ask them to stay.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No need to put me in charge. Before you get your train, could you taste this soup?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm merely helping this reach the right outcome. I'll fix that. You'll need to check again.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My train leaves in ten minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. That's when the bread comes out.

mechanism: A poses as an undemanding host while choosing food service timing that repeatedly gives a departing visitor reasons to remain.
confusable: Not directly asking for company or helplessly discovering delays: A calmly controls tasting and serving order while minimizing its role.
comparison: Repeated tasting and planned bread delay versus packed gift becoming tasting prerequisite.
